feature: High-school resume and recruit Notes expansion
status: Stages 1-3 offline prototype completed; 24-example review ready. Awaiting the approved content-review checkpoint before expanding prose and native integration.

stages.name: Data audit
nativeLinkChecks: Luke Callen UI RecordId 561120980 matches active Recruit row serial
stages.nativeProductionGrade: Present, but semantics unverified; excluded from the model
stages.birthdate: Zero/default values normalized as unavailable; not relied on as the primary identity
stages.persistenceDesign: Use saved PresentationId plus LeagueID and immutable biography; save path/week/scouting/ratings/age/position are excluded. First generated resume will be persisted at native integration; cross-process persistence is not yet implemented.

stages.name: Previous-season generator
stages.note: These are model behaviors, not claims about actual high-school statistical distributions. Mean-direction checks do not prove resistance to every multivariate rating-inference strategy.

stages.name: Development treatment
stages.policy: Production, opportunity and competition exclude development. Only a common positional-settling background probability changes mildly: Normal/Impact 12%, Star 15%, Elite 18%, and only appears when an existing role explanation does not take priority. All development groups can receive it.
stages.checks: 22,000 controlled fixtures and all 3,721 real-input resumes retain identical statistics/opportunity/class when only development changes.

stages.name: Contrasting dossier review
stages.coverage: All 21 positions present in the loaded HS class plus all five opportunity roles; includes Luke and Dylan. Hidden evaluation is separately expandable.
stages.scope: Review covers generated previous-season statistics and initial background; the larger scouting-prose library is stage 5.

model.stateInterpretation: Soft ordinal strength bands; not measured distances between ranks
model.competition: 50% state baseline, 32% generated classification, 18% individual schedule variation
model.classification: Generated consistent 1A-6A scale; not state association classifications
model.ratings: Read-only actual position skills; never modifies game ratings or outcomes
model.records: No school/state/national record claims without a supported record baseline

tests: RecruitResumeTools.exe --self-test (22,000 boundary resumes + 8,000 paired QB comparisons pass)
Entire live HS class generated, validated, repeated deterministically and development-isolation checked
limits: Offline prototype only; live p18 report is unchanged
Native persistence and automatic MMC loading remain later stages
Statistical ranges and contextual language are subject to the sample review
Broader multivariate information-leak calibration remains before native release
No historical record database or real state-specific classification mapping
